simple.meaning: פָּלָה (pâlâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “to distinguish (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פָּלָה (H6395) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 8:18, with occurrences in Exodus, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּלָה (H6395) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פָּלָה (H6395) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פָּלָה (pâlâh) / H6395 is traced through Exodus 8:18, Exodus 9:4, Exodus 11:7, Exodus 33:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.usage: put a difference, show marvellous, separate, set apart, sever, make wonderfully.
definitions.full: H6395. palah [ מָּלָה ] verb Niph`al be separated, distinct (|| form of פלא q. v.; compare Arabic , separate from sucking, wean ; Ethiopic separate, distinguish ); — 1 Perfect 1plural consecutive וְנִפְלִינוּ Exod 33:16 and we shall be distinct , with מִן person 2 1singular נִפְלֵיתִי Psa 139:14 I am wonderful (namely in bodily stature etc.); < Vrss Hupfeld Now Bae We תָ - thou [ ׳י ] art wonderful ( פלא 3 ). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הִפְלָה Psa 4:4 , ׳וְה consecutive Exod 9:4 ; 1 singular וְהִפְלֵיתִי consecutive 8:18 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יַפְלֶה 11:7 ; Imperative masculine singular הַפְלֵה Psa 17:7 ; — of ׳י , make separate , with accusative Exod 8:18 (by treating differently); set apart Psa 4:4 , but perhaps read לִי חֶסֶד (for Mt לוֺ חָסִיד ), hath made wonderful (his) kindness to me (Dy Gr Che We Du [Bae 'perhaps']), so 17:7 (compare 31:22 ); distinguish between, בֵּין thing, Exod 9:4 , בֵּין person 11:7 .
